Hypothesis

Increase local prices and make them equal to USD price in local price and check how it affect final revenue and amount of users. Launch experiment only in locations where price will be changed.

A/B test plan

Base value of the metric: APRU except USD, EUR, CHF, GBP$1.14
Lift, %10%
Minimal detectable effect0.0214
Probability of true-positive (power)0.8
Probability of false-positive (p-value)0.05
Sample size (for all the variations)68895
How many days it'll take to conduct the test45

Description of the Solution & Mockups

Solution

  • In the test variations, we offer increased price everywhere except USD, EUR, CHF, GBP
    • B: increased price - we’re aligning all local prices to USD.
  • Adjust the discount amount everywhere it appears
  • We've decided to create a new list of plan IDs for a new "tier" because we need options to separate plans with different local prices. So, we'll be rolling out new plan IDs and plan codes for all countries, regardless of the fact that prices will only change for some merchants.

query Expand source 
select geo
, floor(avg(landing)) as landing
, floor(avg(paywall)) as paywall
from (
select date
, if(country in ('AT', 'BE', 'DE', 'LI', 'LU', 'MC', 'NL', 'FR', 'DK', 'IE', 'IS', 'LV', 'LT', 'NO', 'FI', 'SE', 'GR', 'ES', 'IT', 'MT', 'PT', 'SM', 'SI', 'HR'), 'EU'
, country
) as geo
, uniqExactIf(unified_id, event = 'Landing Upgrade Open') as landing
, uniqIf(unified_id, event = 'Landing Plans View') as paywall
from ug_rt_events_web
where date between toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 38 day and toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 8 day
and event in ('Landing Plans View', 'Landing Upgrade Open')
and country in ('AU', 'BR', 'CA', 'CH', 'CZ', 'GB', 'JP', 'PL', 'MX', 'NZ', 'KR', 'RU', 'NZ', 'US'
, 'AT', 'BE', 'DE', 'LI', 'LU', 'MC', 'NL', 'FR', 'DK', 'IE', 'IS', 'LV', 'LT', 'NO', 'FI', 'SE', 'GR', 'ES', 'IT', 'MT', 'PT', 'SM', 'SI', 'HR')
group by date, geo
)
group by geo
query Expand source 
with raw as (
    select
        subscription_id,
        product_id,
        minIf(datetime, event = 'Subscribed') as sub_dt,
        minIf(datetime, event = 'Charged') as ch_dt,
        argMinIf(local_currency, datetime, event = 'Subscribed') as currency,
        argMinIf(usd_price, datetime, event = 'Charged') as revenue
    from
        default.ug_subscriptions_events
    where
        date between toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 38 day and toDate('2024-06-05')
    and
        platform = 'UG_WEB'
    and
        event in ('Subscribed', 'Charged')
    and
        subscription_id <> '' and product_id <> ''
    group by
        subscription_id,
        product_id
    having
        toDate(sub_dt) between toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 38 day and toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 8 day
    and
        (toDate(ch_dt) >= toDate('2024-06-05') - interval 30 day or toDateTime(ch_dt) = toDateTime(0))
)


select
    currency,
    avg(accesses) as accesses,
    avg(charges) as charges,
    avg(revenue) as revenue
from (
    select
        toDate(sub_dt) as date,
        currency,
        uniqExact((subscription_id, product_id)) as accesses,
        uniqExactIf((subscription_id, product_id), toDateTime(ch_dt) > toDateTime(0)) as charges,
        sum(revenue) as revenue
    from
        raw
    group by
        date,
        currency
)
group by
    currency
